title: Natural tourism-series View geometry and sparse trend residual
hypothesis: For monthly tourism series, one frozen Chronos-T5-Tiny and a shared rank-2 output LoRA basis with a per-series one-angle View m can recover useful held-out forecast behavior using much less adaptation state than independent per-series rank-2 LoRA. A support-selected one-scalar horizon-trend residual should recover series-specific trend errors only for a minority of series; if it is needed broadly or a byte-matched diagonal control matches the View, the proposed natural shared orbit is not established.
physical_object: One frozen Chronos-T5-Tiny checkpoint and one shared rank-2 lm_head LoRA basis trained on fit tourism series.
mirror_coordinate: One support-inferred angle m_s rotates the shared two-dimensional LoRA latent for each held-out series. A separate optional scalar r_s shifts the forecast mean along a fixed normalized horizon ramp, estimated only from support windows and selected by a threshold chosen on development series.
logical_multiplicity: Few-shot forecast functions across held-out monthly tourism series from one physical Chronos model and one shared low-rank basis.

data.split_rule: Sort T9..T366 by SHA256(series_name UTF-8); first 40 fit, next 16 development, next 24 fresh audit. Split assignment uses names only. Freeze all IDs before parsing numeric values. If any selected series has <80 observations or missing/nonfinite values, mark NOT ESTABLISHED; do not substitute another series.

model.updates: 30 shared-basis updates; per-series support adaptation updates selected from [10,30,60] on dev only.

split.per_series: Each series' first 60% is the support/training range. Development/audit query target is one 12-month forecast beginning at floor(80% of series length); context is the preceding 12 months. MASE scaling uses only first-60% observations, lag 12.
split.fit_series: Train shared basis only on fit IDs and first-60% observations.
split.development_series: Choose update count, residual threshold and regularization on dev IDs only.
split.audit_series: Audit IDs remain unopened until source, model, all gates and dev choices are frozen.

controls: Pooled rank-2 LoRA trained on fit series, no per-series coordinate
Shared rank-2 basis + per-series Mirror angle
Same basis with per-series diagonal gain at byte-near state
Same basis with two direct latent gains
Mirror + optional support-selected scalar trend residual
Independent per-series rank-2 LoRA adapted on identical support windows

development.selection: Macro MASE; residual threshold selected only via support-only dev folds, tie-break on actual serialized state bytes.

metrics.primary: Per-series and macro MASE across two sampling draws
secondary: family/group MASE by public series code where available
fraction of audit series selecting a trend residual

paid_objects: per-series angle, trend residual and ID map

success_gate: On held-out series, Mirror improves MASE by >=2% over native and pooled controls, is within 5% of independent LoRA, beats same-cost diagonal by >0.1%, uses <10% of independent adaptation state, and optional residual is selected for <=25% of audit series; serialized replay passes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any quality gate; diagonal gain aliases it within 0.1%; residual is needed by >25% of audit series or erases the state advantage; or independent per-series LoRA reveals the shared orbit is too restrictive.
not_established_gate: Pinned data/model unavailable, a preregistered series is structurally ineligible (<80 observations or missing values), or required controls cannot be run.
boundaries: This is one monthly tourism benchmark screen, not broad temporal capacity evidence.
The first eight series were previewed accidentally and are excluded; no forecast metrics were inspected.
No audit values may be read before the fresh freeze; the frozen series-ID list and archive hashes are committed first.
Report adapter-state savings separately from full payload because the pretrained checkpoint dominates.
Chronos/PEMS-BAY overlap from MA-1058 is irrelevant to dataset independence; Monash tourism is a distinct benchmark family.

amendments.timing: After the deterministic initial development screen and before opening any audit-series values
amendments.reason: Source review found a pooled LoRA forward hook left active during support-fold residual scoring, and the residual least-squares denominator multiplied by the number of support windows twice. The initial residual threshold and residual-enabled dev metrics are invalidated and preserved under runs/dev/invalidated_hook_residual/.
amendments.change: Explicitly deactivate unused hooks; correct the trend residual denominator; select a dimensionless minimum relative support-fold MASE improvement threshold, including null/no-residual, constrained to <=25% dev residual allocation. Keep all series IDs, model, standard method controls, seeds, and audit split unchanged.
amendments.audit_access: No numeric audit series values were loaded; the frozen 24 audit IDs remain sealed.
